bounded_hypothesis: The packaged CLI can take every supported host from a fresh install to an unambiguous actionable repair workflow and same-surface reverify contract without a human operator or provider call.
candidate_delta: Add a reusable built-CLI activation runner and fail-closed report validator for install, pre-DESIGN diagnosis, establish routing, deterministic DESIGN fixture, ready diagnosis, repair routing, and reverify ownership.
first_failure_rule: Any channel, state transition, workflow selection, ambiguity, reverify contract, hidden human step, provider call, or over-30-second run fails the funnel.
rollback_gate: Revert if the built CLI cannot reproduce the four-channel funnel from a clean temporary project.
claim_boundary: The runner injects a deterministic DESIGN.md fixture. It proves install-to-actionable-workflow orchestration, not model-generated UI quality or a resolved surface.
decision: Close the provider-free technical activation funnel. The next resolved-surface evidence must include an actual model runtime and evaluator rather than relabeling the deterministic fixture.
